loss_normalization_boundary.original_lc_rec: Each rank microbatch causal shifted CE is a mean over its valid labels; accumulation/rank averaging does not equal a full-window token mean when answer lengths differ.
loss_normalization_boundary.current_trainer_default_risk: Qwen3.forward accepts **kwargs; Trainer can pass num_items_in_batch across the accumulation window. Native 4.57.6 Trainer loss scaling must not be called equivalent to original 4.31 LC-Rec without an explicit adapter.
loss_normalization_boundary.this_cpu_probe: The uninitialized Trainer object has model_accepts_loss_kwargs=False and compute_loss_func=None only for index iteration; no loss, model, optimizer, backward or training executed.
loss_normalization_boundary.required_bounded_gpu_scope: Explicit per-micro CE with no temperature and no num_items_in_batch; original rank/micro averaging must be evidenced independently.
loss_normalization_boundary.epoch_tail_limit: Native Trainer sets current_gradient_accumulation_steps to actual final chunk size. The bounded DeepSpeed loop uses full global128; exact short-tail numerical behavior with DeepSpeed is NOT TESTED by this CPU protocol audit.

checkpoint_scope.checkpoint_policy: Four epoch checkpoints plus final save_model; save_total_limit=5; lowest eval_loss; load_best_model_at_end.
checkpoint_scope.full_state_by_source: save_only_model=False invokes model, optimizer/scheduler, scaler as applicable, RNG and Trainer JSON state saving. DeepSpeed-specific state layout is not written here.
not_measured: Real model selection and best restoration

limitations: CPU sharding traverses only dummy integer record IDs in one epoch per rank; all four epoch batch-size and callback traces follow inspected installed control flow, not a model run.
prepare_data_loader is explicitly parameterized for two ranks on one CPU process; no distributed CPU process group or GPU is created.
Sampler identities and tail sizes are real Accelerate 1.12 outputs, but Dataset prompt/query/preference RNG behavior and communication are outside this probe.
The dummy Trainer object bypasses __init__ to avoid model/optimizer initialization; actual set_initial_training_values, sampler, get_batch_samples and DefaultFlowCallback methods are invoked.
